regime.label: RISK-OFF / NASDAQ-SPECIFIC BREAKDOWN INTO NVDA EARNINGS WEEK -- and for the first time in weeks the desk's 100%-long-put book is the RIGHT side of the tape
evidence: Settled 13:36:14Z quotes (NOT the opening auction -- see the re-quote note): QQQ 706.955 (-0.91% vs the 713.44 close), SPY 763.535 (-0.29% vs 765.72).

THE LEVEL THAT MATTERS, and it flipped back in the desk's favour: QQQ is BELOW BOTH its 20d (709.19) and its 50d (713.44). Friday's open had reclaimed the 50d and the brief correctly flagged that as undoing the bearish premise; today it is undone again in the other direction. Recomputed this run from 50 regular-hours closes through 2026-08-21.

THE DIVERGENCE WORTH OWNING: SPY is still ABOVE both its 20d (762.33) and 50d (751.75). So this is a NASDAQ/semis problem, not a broad-market break -- which is exactly why the QQQ put is the better-positioned of the two index bets and why the SPY 700P hedge remains far out of the money.

Leadership is semis, to the downside: AMD 460.52 (-2.69%), TSM 411.08 (-1.88%), TSLA 354.64 (-2.26%), AVGO 364.845 (-0.98%), NVDA 213.09 (-0.76%). MSFT 483.57 (+0.07%) is the lone green name -- the same defensive-megacap rotation signature as a genuine risk-off day.

VOL IS BIDDING, and this time it is not an auction artifact: own-measured 30d ATM IV rose on 6 of 8 core names versus Friday's SETTLED readings -- SPY 0.1272->0.1304 (+2.5%), QQQ 0.1929->0.1994 (+3.4%), NVDA 0.4042->0.4227 (+4.6%), AVGO +3.8%. Friday's fade of the 'vol is finally bidding' read does not apply to today's print.

DRIVERS (press, not desk inference): 30-year Treasury yields at 19-year highs (~5.33%) pressuring long-duration/capital-intensive AI names; US-Canada trade talks breaking down; the administration's vowed economic war with Iran; and an overnight Alibaba-dilution/memory selloff out of Asia. Week ahead carries NVDA earnings (Wed pm), PCE, and Jackson Hole.
regime.implication: Three things follow and they point the same way. (1) The book is finally working: +$95 at mark, with the QQQ 680P +$169. (2) That is precisely why NO new bearish entry was taken -- the book self-levers as it wins (net short delta -$61,049 = 15.1x account, up from 13.8x Friday on the SAME three positions, purely via gamma), so adding downside here compounds a one-way bet rather than diversifying it. (3) Buying premium today means paying a vol bid, after the gap, two days before the single largest scheduled variance event of the quarter. The setup that would have been A-grade was available last Tuesday, not this morning. The honest read: manage the winner, bring Ryan the decision, do not chase.
